command:
set -euo pipefail; BUILD=build/idf-stage28e-c-memory-audit-v1; ELF="$BUILD/growbox_ml_controller.elf"; NM=$(find /Users/michal/.espressif/tools -type f -path '*/bin/xtensa-esp32s3-elf-nm' -perm -111 2>/dev/null | head -1); READELF=$(find /Users/michal/.espressif/tools -type f -path '*/bin/xtensa-esp32s3-elf-readelf' -perm -111 2>/dev/null | head -1); test -n "$NM"; test -x "$NM"; echo STAGE28E_C_NM=$NM; "$NM" -S --size-sort --radix=d "$ELF" > /tmp/stage28e-c-nm.txt; python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
rows=[]
for line in Path('/tmp/stage28e-c-nm.txt').read_text(errors='replace').splitlines():
    p=line.split(None,4)
    if len(p)<4: continue
    try: size=int(p[1])
    except ValueError: continue
    typ=p[2]; name=p[3] if len(p)==4 else p[4]
    if typ in 'BbDdSsGgCc': rows.append((size,typ,name))
print('STAGE28E_C_TOP_STATIC_SYMBOLS_BEGIN')
for size,typ,name in sorted(rows,reverse=True)[:80]: print(f'{size:8d} {typ} {name}')
print('STAGE28E_C_TOP_STATIC_SYMBOLS_END')
PY
if test -n "$READELF" && test -x "$READELF"; then "$READELF" -S --wide "$ELF" | grep -E ' \.(data|bss|iram0.text|dram0.data|dram0.bss|flash.text|flash.rodata|rtc)' || true; fi; echo STAGE28E_C_SYMBOL_AUDIT_PASS
